title.value: Hybrid Harmony: A Multi-Person Neurofeedback Application for Interpersonal Synchrony
title.justification: The paper is clearly focused on the Hybrid Harmony application, as reflected in both the title and throughout the content.
title.quote: Hybrid Harmony: A Multi-Person Neurofeedback Application for Interpersonal Synchrony.

analysis.description: The paper describes the development and application of Hybrid Harmony, a multi-person neurofeedback software designed to facilitate the study and improvement of interpersonal synchrony during real-world social interactions. It utilizes hyperscanning techniques to analyze inter-brain connectivity through EEG data and supports real-time visualization and sonification.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical results from studies using the Hybrid Harmony application and discusses its validation and application in real-world settings.
type.quote: We report results from 236 dyads experiencing synchrony neurofeedback during naturalistic face-to-face interactions..."

name.justification: The research is primarily focused on developing a neurofeedback application, fitting within the field of Neurotechnology.
name.quote: This article was submitted to Neurotechnology and Systems Neuroergonomics, a section of the journal Frontiers in Neuroergonomics.

name.justification: The paper discusses the Hybrid Harmony application as a Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) designed for facilitating interpersonal synchrony.
name.quote: Building on our previous work... we describe the biofeedback application Hybrid Harmony, a Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)..."

name.justification: The application uses EEG data to perform hyperscanning and analyze inter-brain connectivity.
name.quote: While hyperscanning research is also conducted using hemodynamic neuroimaging tools... we here focus on electroencephalography (EEG) hyperscanning."

name.justification: The dataset from the Mutual Wave Machine is used to validate the Hybrid Harmony application in capturing socially relevant self-report measures.
name.quote: To validate that Hybrid Harmony can capture socially relevant self-report measures, we used a dataset of 243 dyads participating in the Mutual Wave Machine..."
